events.title: Tomorrow our campsite officially opens in DEMO
events.summary: Just one more day until the Camp Manager Simulator DEMO is available to everyone! We're genuinely excited and hope you'll love it as much as we do. We put a lot of dedication into creating it, and we're really eager to hear your thoughts on the demo. Your feedback - everything you enjoyed or anything that didn't quite click - is incredibly valuable to us. We're looking forward to hearing from you! In the meantime, don't forget to wishlist our game and stay tuned for the big release!
